subtitle: Lesson 30 · Async Python for AI Workloads

code:
async def call_api(client, prompt):
    resp = await client.post(URL, json={"prompt": prompt})
    return resp.json()["text"]

async def main():
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        coros = (call_api(client, p) for p in prompts)
        return await asyncio.gather(*coros)
caption: gather() runs every call concurrently — ~1s total, not ~3s.

steps.label: All coroutines start together
steps.sub: No waiting for one before the next

steps.label: Results come back as a list
steps.sub: In the order you passed them in
